name: commit-review
description: Oppositional review of a single commit and the seams it touches, by a model you choose (reviewer: gpt-sol, opus, sonnet, glm, deepseek). Works only through gh: no checkout, nothing posted to GitHub. The review comes back as collect.review (with collect.verdict), readable by whoever triggered or spawned the run.
author: arbitron

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: GitHub repo in owner/name format (e.g. dbinky/arbitron).

inputs.name: commit
inputs.description: Commit id to review (7-40 hex characters).

inputs.name: reviewer
inputs.description: Which model reviews: gpt-sol, opus, sonnet, glm or deepseek. Pick a different family from the commit's author for an oppositional read.

inputs.name: focus
inputs.description: Optional extra focus for the reviewer (e.g. 'merge resolution in adapter/claudecli').

nodes.label: Check commit
nodes.description: Resolve the commit through gh and fail fast if repo or commit is wrong. Emits the full sha, title and parents.

nodes.label: Pick reviewer
nodes.description: Branch on the reviewer input. Each branch runs the same template on a different model profile.

nodes.label: Review: GPT Sol (gpt-6.1-sol, codex, high)
nodes.description: Oppositional review of one commit and the seams it touches, read-only through gh. Final message is the review.

nodes.label: Review: Claude Opus (claude-code, high)
nodes.description: Oppositional review of one commit and the seams it touches, read-only through gh. Final message is the review.

nodes.label: Review: Claude Sonnet (claude-code, high)
nodes.description: Oppositional review of one commit and the seams it touches, read-only through gh. Final message is the review.

nodes.label: Review: GLM 5.2 (Ollama Cloud, opencode)
nodes.description: Oppositional review of one commit and the seams it touches, read-only through gh. Final message is the review.

nodes.label: Review: DeepSeek V4 Pro (Ollama Cloud, opencode)
nodes.description: Oppositional review of one commit and the seams it touches, read-only through gh. Final message is the review.

nodes.label: Unknown reviewer
nodes.description: Fail with the accepted reviewer values instead of guessing a model.

nodes.label: Collect review
nodes.description: Join the branches: lift the one review that ran into collect.review, with its reviewer and parsed verdict.
